Version 1.0.4

- Updated documentation in SKILL.md for improved clarity and alignment with current features.
- Removed redundant documentation file (skill-card.md) to streamline resource organization.
- Internal adjustments in configuration and utility scripts for better maintainability.
- No changes to external interface, core features, or user workflows.

- Major update: User identity (open-id) is now managed automatically by the system; users no longer need to provide or see any identity parameter.
- Updated documentation for clarity, conciseness, and improved formatting in SKILL.md.
- Strengthened security: explicit prohibition against exposing or requesting any identity value from users.
- Simplified usage—skill triggers and report queries now fully automatic; history queries always fetch from the cloud API, never from local or memory.
- Old user prompts about identity removed from scripts and documentation.
- Cleaned up files: obsolete and redundant files removed.

- Updated SKILL.md to clarify and simplify the open-id configuration file search order and paths.
- Moved skill-level config.yaml path to scripts/config.yaml instead of skills/smyx_common/scripts/config.yaml.
- Revised and condensed the description for clarity and brevity.
- Added license metadata ("MIT-0").
- Removed obsolete or redundant documentation files (e.g., skill-card.md).

Initial release.

- Enables automatic analysis of UAV-acquired farmland images to compute vegetation indices (NDVI, NDRE, etc.) and generate farm health-index heatmaps.
- Identifies problem areas (e.g., nutrient/water deficiency, pests, disease, weeds) and outputs coordinates and area for each zone.
- Provides structured, index-based assessment (but not specific agricultural operation advice).
- Includes strict open-id acquisition and validation procedures to ensure secure report management.
- Supports querying and structured display of historical health index analysis reports via API.
- Workflow guides users on required input formats, processing steps, and result interpretation.
